The 2023 Kia Forte LXS is an outstanding sedan that combines efficiency, advanced safety technologies, and driving comfort. This model features a powerful **2L I-4 DOHC engine** with an impressive **147 horsepower** paired with a continuous variable transmission CVT, ensuring a thrilling driving experience while optimizing fuel economy.

One of the standout features of the Forte LXS is its innovative **Hands-on steering assist/lane centering** technology. This system makes long road trips significantly more relaxing by allowing drivers to set their desired speed while the vehicle automatically adjusts its pace and maintains a safe distance from surrounding vehicles. This feature minimizes driver stress and enhances overall safety during travel.

Safety is a top priority in the Forte LXS, highlighted by the **Forward collision mitigation** system. This proactive feature detects potential collisions and prepares the vehicle and its occupants to minimize the severity of any impact, offering peace of mind on the road. Complementing this is the **Lane departure prevention** system, which actively assists in keeping the vehicle centered within its lane, providing an extra layer of safety for both the driver and other road users.

The **Rear camera** feature is another essential addition, providing a clear view of obstacles behind the vehicle, making reversing maneuvers safer and more convenient. Additionally, the incorporation of **Brake assist** ensures rapid response in emergency situations by applying maximum stopping power when panic braking is detected.

For added convenience, the Forte LXS features **Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls**, allowing drivers to maintain a preset speed effortlessly, especially beneficial during long commutes. The **Touchscreen** interface enhances the user experience by allowing easy access to various features and information at a glance, making every drive more enjoyable.
